entries.text: Workspace admins can add several [Databricks](/connectors/cloud-integrations/databricks), Snowflake or Fabric connections per workspace and manage every kind through one flow.
SpecklePy's IFC importer converts elements outside the spatial structure and respects each quantity's own units. Version 2026.9.2.
SpecklePy's IFC importer no longer triangulates opening elements. Version 2026.9.2.
SpecklePy's IFC importer brings in line geometry for elements that have no 3D representation. Version 2026.9.2.
Files attached to a shared skill are listed only for members who can read them.
ProjectWise sync connection URLs are accepted only as HTTPS addresses on bentley.com hosts.
A saved ProjectWise login can be used only by the member who saved it, in its own workspace, and Trimble Connect syncs use only their workspace's connection.
The admin user query no longer returns the ids of a user's active password-reset tokens.
Federations of many models load every model's interactions, placements and filter properties instead of failing when the viewer's request queue fills.
Insights link, preview and return only data files the user can read, and stored insights resolve lookup tables only from files in their own workspace.
The camera settles when a pivot pick lands during WASD flight; merged, not yet in a viewer release.
Markdown in chat messages, shared conversations, skills and Automate function READMEs renders without running embedded scripts, and validation rule descriptions display as text.
The issues list widget shows issue descriptions as text instead of rendering embedded HTML.

Revit uploads and ACC Revit syncs have an opt-in **Extract room relations** setting that publishes [room membership and room-to-room connections](/developers/object-model/relations#containment-and-grouping).
Camera navigation is held within a bounding sphere around the loaded models.
Shift-clicking a model's checkbox in the project models list selects or clears every model shown between it and the previous one clicked.
Camera controls clamp navigation to the world bounds sphere. Version 2026.10.9.
Point cloud files (LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY, PCD, PTS, PTX, XYZ and ReCap) can be uploaded on app.speckle.systems, as a preview.
